data.name: Bulbasaur
data.flavorText: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

data.name: Tangela
data.flavorText: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.

data.name: Pineco

attacks.name: Guard Press
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, this Pokémon takes 30 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).

data.flavorText: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.

data.name: Sewaddle
data.flavorText: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.

attacks.name: Bind Down
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.name: Venusaur ex
rules: Pokémon ex rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

abilities.name: Tranquil Flower
abilities.text: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may heal 60 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.

attacks.name: Dangerous Toxwhip
attacks.text: Your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Confused and Poisoned.

attacks.name: Precocious Evolution
attacks.text: If you go first, you can use this attack during your first turn. Search your deck for a card that evolves from this Pokémon and put it onto this Pokémon to evolve it. Then, shuffle your deck.

data.name: Scyther

attacks.name: Slashing Strike
attacks.text: During your next turn, this Pokémon can't use Slashing Strike.

data.flavorText: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.

data.name: Caterpie
data.flavorText: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.

data.name: Alakazam

abilities.name: Damage Swap
abilities.text: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may move 1 damage counter from 1 of your Pokémon to another as long as you don't Knock Out that Pokémon. This power can't be used if Alakazam is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.

attacks.name: Confuse Ray
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Confused.

data.flavorText: Its brain can outperform a supercomputer. Its intelligence quotient is said to be 5000.

data.name: Oddish
data.flavorText: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

data.name: Pineco
data.flavorText: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

data.name: Weedle

attacks.name: Surprise Attack
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If tails, this attack does nothing.

data.flavorText: Often found in forests and grasslands. It has a sharp, toxic barb of around two inches on top of its head.

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

attacks.name: Gooey Thread
attacks.text: During your opponent's next turn, the Defending Pokémon can't retreat.

data.name: Surskit

attacks.name: Triple Spin
attacks.text: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: It secretes a thick, sweet-scented syrup from the tip of its head. It lives on weed-choked ponds.

data.name: Oddish
data.flavorText: Its scientific name is Oddium wanderus. It is said to cover distances as far as 1,000 feet when night falls, walking on its two roots.

data.name: Mewtwo

attacks.name: Psychic
attacks.text: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy card attached to the Defending Pokémon.

attacks.name: Barrier
attacks.text: Discard 1 Psychic Energy card attached to Mewtwo in order to prevent all effects of attacks, including damage, done to Mewtwo during your opponent's next turn.

data.flavorText: A scientist created this Pokémon after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA engineering experiments.

data.name: Snivy
data.flavorText: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.

data.name: Ethan's Pinsir

attacks.name: Rallying Horn
attacks.text: If any of your Ethan's Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack during your opponent's last turn, this attack does 100 more damage.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.

data.name: Oddish

attacks.name: Leaf Boomerang
attacks.text: Flip 2 coins. This attack does 10 damage for each heads.

data.flavorText: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.

data.name: Tropius

attacks.name: Fruity Aroma
attacks.text: Look at the top 6 cards of your deck, and you may reveal any number of Pokémon you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.

data.flavorText: Delicious fruits grew out from around its neck because it always ate the same kind of fruit.

data.name: Erika's Oddish

attacks.name: Reckless Charge
attacks.text: This Pokémon also does 10 damage to itself.

data.flavorText: When it is woken by moonlight, it wanders about. But during the day, it stays still underground.

data.name: Hoppip

attacks.name: Splashing Dodge
attacks.text: Flip a coin. If heads, during your opponent's next turn, prevent all damage from and effects of attacks done to this Pokémon.

data.flavorText: This Pokémon is blown across vast distances by the wind. It is unclear where the Hoppip of Paldea originally came from.
